name: Fitzhugh-Nagumo
header:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<VTKFile type="ImageData" version="0.1" byte_order="LittleEndian" compressor="vtkZLibDataCompressor">
  <RD format_version="1">
  
    <rule name="Fitzhugh-Nagumo" type="formula">
      <param name="timestep">  0.02   </param>
      <param name="a0">        -0.1   </param>
      <param name="a1">        2      </param>
      <param name="epsilon">   0.018  </param>
      <param name="delta">     3      </param>
      <param name="k1">        1      </param>
      <param name="k2">        0      </param>
      <param name="k3">        1      </param>
      <formula number_of_chemicals="2">
        delta_a = k1*a - k2*a*a - a*a*a - b + laplacian_a;
        delta_b = epsilon*(k3*a - a1*b - a0) + delta*laplacian_b;
      </formula>
    </rule>

    <initial_pattern_generator apply_when_loading="true">
      <overlay chemical="a">
        <overwrite/>
        <constant value="-1" />
        <everywhere />
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="a">
        <overwrite/>
        <white_noise low="0.6" high="1" />
        <rectangle>
            <point3D x="0.2" y="0.4" z="0.3" />
            <point3D x="0.5" y="0.6" z="0.7" />
        </rectangle>
        <rectangle>
            <point3D x="0.5" y="0.5" z="0.5" />
            <point3D x="0.8" y="0.65" z="0.8" />
        </rectangle>
        <circle radius="0.2">
            <point3D x="0.5" y="0.5" z="0.2" />
        </circle>
      </overlay>
    </initial_pattern_generator>
   
    <render_settings>
        <low value="-1" />
        <high value="1" />
        <slice_3D value="false" />
    </render_settings>
    
  </RD>
  <ImageData WholeExtent="0 255 0 255 0 0"></ImageData>
</VTKFile>
